tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// byang gter phur pa spu gri'i phrin las kyi byang bu rig mchog 'bum sde'i bcud dril bzhugs so//

na maḥshrī gu ru badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ rdo rje khros pa'i gzi brjid kyis// srid gsum gdug pa'i mun 'joms pa// de nyid sgrub pa'i phrin las ni// bye ba'i yang zhun 'di nyid do// sbyor ba dkyil 'khor gtor mchod so so'i skabs su babs pa'i dgos pa khyad 'brel gyi bca' gzhi mthong brgyud ltar tshogs par byas nas/ dngos gzhi phrin las kyi rim pa la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud 'debs kyi 'phros su/ bka' brgyad rang shar las 'byung ba gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs sems sdom bzung dam bca' tshad med bzhi ngag dang phreng ba rdor dril phur pa yo byad rnams byin brlab/ yan lag bcu pas tshogs bsags/ bgegs gtor btang*/ rgyal chen mchod nas 'dir 'jug pa yin yang*/ spros pa nyer bsdu'i skabs de tsam mi 'grub na brgyud 'debs 'phros/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyis tshogs gsag yan lag brgyad pa bya/ bgegs gtor spyi 'tsham gtang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'ang bsdu na/ hūm̐: ston pa'i bka' nyan 'jig rten 'dul: thugs rje'i thabs kyis bgegs rigs 'joms: sprul sku rgyal chen sde bzhi po: phyi mtshams bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sprul sku rgyal chen sde bzhi po: don gyi sangs rgyas yin mod kyang: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa ya swā hā: oṃ bai rū ḍha kā ya swā hā: oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣa ya swā hā: oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya swā hā: zhes pa tsam bya/ de nas mtshams gcad pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: rngam brjid rol pa'i stangs stabs can: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa drag po'i sgra: stong gsum khro bo rngam pas gang: tshur 'dus phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu: 'jig rten dregs pa brdzis pa'i steng: e nṛ tri sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: de steng 'jigs byed khro bo bcu: zhal nas drag po'i gsung 'di sgrog:

hūm̐: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa: stobs chen khro bo chen po yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: gal te bka' las 'das gyur na: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+rā nān: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya: sarba duṣ+ṭān: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: kī li kī la ya: sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta: badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dang po phyi mtshams gcad pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad du: nga la bar chad byed pa rnams: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas bar mtshams gcad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu ste: thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu: mi dge bcu rnams tshar bcad nas: rnam thar lam la 'jug bya'i phyir: ma dag pa rnams mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ gardza gardza: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: bhan+dha bhan+dha: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: tshin+dha tshin+dha: bhin+da bhin+da: s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas gsang mtshams gcad pa ni: hūm̐: steng yang phur pa'i gur khang la: phur pa'i thog chen thog ltar 'beb: 'og kyang phur pa'i sa gzhi la: phur pa'i 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar: phyogs mtshams phur pa'i drwa bas gtams: phur pa'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: phur pa'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: khro bo'i zhal rnams phyir gzigs nas: mtshon cha mang pos dgra bgegs sgrol: bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni:

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dza dza: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus dgongs su gsol: chos sku rnam dag longs sku dbyings nas bzhengs: sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa phur pa'i lha: rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs: bskal pa dpag med dus nas da lta'i bar: dug lnga'i dbang gyur ngan song gsum gyi las: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang du: bdag cag dad pas 'jug 'tshal gyis: tshad med lha mo sgo ma bzhi: ye shes bzhi yi sgo phyes shig: bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: ho: yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro dam can rdo rje mched: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas dam bca' ba ni: ho: lhag pa'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rtag tu 'gro don bya ba dang: byang chub sems kyi dam bca' 'o: bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de nas byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ a la la ho: bha ga bān: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang: ye shes sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo bcu: thabs dang shes rab rdo rje mche gshog dang: phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs mdzad kī la ya: ye shes sgo skyong sgo ma chen mo bzhi: ma mo bcu gnyis sgo ma bcu gnyis dang: rig 'dzin rgyal po rgyal thebs gzungs ma dang: ging dang las mkhan mched dang lcam dral dang: rdo rje lhag sdud bka' nyan dam can tshogs: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: sgrub mchog sngags 'chang bdag la dbang skur cig: dam rdzas sgrub rten rnams la byin phob cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ā be sha ya ā: de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hūm̐: thams cad ye shes cho 'phrul yin: dri zhim bdug spos dhū las byung: bkrag mdangs me tog pu las byung: gsal ba'i mar me ā las byung: gtsang ma'i dri chab gha las byung: bcud ldan lha bshos na las byung: snyan pa'i rol mo sha las byung: thams cad ye shes mchod pa'i rdzas: badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐: badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: badz+ra nai bid+ya hūm̐: badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: badz+ra sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐: hūm̐: rtog med ye shes dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang: 'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod rgya chen spungs: chags med rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khyil: badz+ra kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ kha ta li bh+rūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta ā: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod: mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang: nam mkha'i dbyings nas thigs pa shar: srog gi go ru shar ba dang: snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: āḥdharma dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bh+rūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta sa mā ti hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ suṃ laṃ: hūm̐: mthing nag phaṭa las 'byung ba nam mkha'i klong: ljang nag phaṭa las rgya gram rlung chen bskyil: dmar nag phaṭa las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: dmar gsal hūm̐ las rak+ta'i rba klong 'khyil: ser nag suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal: dkar po laṃ las keng rus ri rab 'bar: de steng oṃ laṃ smug nag 'od ldan shar: snang srid thams cad phur pa'i gzhal yas khang: gru gsum dbal la ngan song gnas bcu rdzogs: rgya mdud 'og ma 'dod khams lha mi'i gnas: lcim gzhog zur brgyad smad la gzugs khams kyi: srid pa'i gnas rigs bcu bdun gnas pa 'o: zur brgyad stod la gzugs med mu bzhi'i lha:

rgya mdud gong ma bde gshegs gzhal yas khang: phyi yi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na bhan+dha dz+nyā na e maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: stong gsum phur bur gsal ba'i rgya mdud la: bh+rūm̐ las rab 'jigs dur khrod gzhal yas khang: gru gsum mthing nag zla gam rin chen 'bar: gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhi mu khyud rdzogs: ngo mtshar pho brang ye shes me 'od gsal: phyi nang med par gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang: hūm̐: de nyid dbus kyi gru gsum lte ba la: badz+ra ti pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: rdo rje brag chen pad+ma nyi zla dang: ru dra dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: rgyu yi hūm̐ yig stan la babs pa las: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: hūm̐: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjes gtams byas te: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus nas bdag la thim: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyings su bdag skyed cig: bde gshegs sku yi gzi brjid thams cad bsdus: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: de las bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam pa'i zhal: g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga bsnams: g.yon gnyis me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khrol: tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: rdo rje khyung gshog dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: sku las bskal pa'i me chen rtsibs stong 'bar: phyogs bcur 'phro zhing srid gsum sreg par byed: khro chung tshon gang bka' nan tshul du brgyan:

thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'od du 'bar: oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: de las yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdangs can: phyag gnyis rdo rje dung khrag 'khril sbyor stob: yab yum bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: sku che yan lag rags shing rngam sgra sgrog: rang rig ma yengs lhang nger gnas par bskyed: yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las: gtso bo'i thugs las phyag rgya bzhi 'phros pas: phyogs skyong bcu po rang dbang med par bkug: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mo ha ghā ta ya nṛ dza: e sarba big nān: gzhal yas phyogs mtshams steng 'og gru gsum steng: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du byi chings bsnol: de steng dpal chen gtso bo'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ hūm̐ sbrel ma bcu 'phros babs pa las: bde gshegs thugs bskul sems can don byas nas: badz+ra badz+ra rdo rje 'bar ba bcu: de nyid 'phro 'dus khro chung skar ltar 'phros: kī la ya hūm̐: steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa: de las hūm̐ kā ra dang sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa'i phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: shar phyogs brgya byin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐: ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: de las rnam par rgyal dang rnam snyems ma: sprul pa'i phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: de las dbyug sngon can dang rdo rje sder: sprul pa'i phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: de las gshin rje gshed dang dur khrod bdag:

sprul pa'i phra men sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐: bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: de las mi g.yo mgon dang gtun khung ma: sprul pa'i phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: nub phyogs klu dbang bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: de las rta mgrin rgyal dang dbang sdud ma: sprul pa'i phra men byi la pu shud mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: de las gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems ma: sprul pa'i phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: byang phyogs gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐: tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: de las bdud rtsi 'khyil dang rlung 'byin ma: sprul pa'i phra men seng ge pha waṃ mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: byang shar dbang ldan bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: bhin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: de las khams gsum rgyal dang gsod byed ma: sprul pa'i phra men dred dang sre mong mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐: s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de las stobs po che dang skyod byed ma: sprul pa'i phra men dom dang byi ba'i mgo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: phyogs bcu khro rgyal yab yum sprul pa'i sku: yab kun mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ri rab phur bu 'dril zhing dgra bgegs sgrol: sku smad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal dang ldan:

rdo rje'i gshog pa dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: phyogs skyong dregs pa thal gyis phyung nas bzhugs: yum bcu mthing nag khro mo'i chas kun rdzogs: phyag g.yas yab 'khyud g.yon kun thod khrag stob: khra thabs kun kyang lcags kyu phur bu 'dril: thugs kar hūm̐ mthar rang rang sngags kyis bskor: hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrog srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: de dag gi bsgom don ni/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i ri rab la phur pa btab pa'i tshul gyis srid pa'i phur bu'i rgya mdud gong ma'i nang du dkyil 'khor gsum bsgom pa la/ bdag bskyed kyi srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ rang gtso bo yab yum gnas bcur khro bo bcu khra phyag nyi shu ba spur bka' nan gyi khro bo lte bar khyung dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor du/ khro bcu khra phyag sgo ma dang bcas yod pa de la phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du grags shing bshad pa'i/ bdag skyed gtso bo dang 'khor gyi shar gyi khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i bar du mtshan ma rdzas dkyil gyi bzhugs gnas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig kyang bsgom dgos pas/ bdag mdun gyi gzhal yas khang gnyis 'don cha tshar gcig gis gsal 'debs/ bdag bskyed grub nas/

hūm̐: dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gru gsum lte ba la: zhes pa nas/ de las bdag nyid ces par/ mdun bskyed sogs bsgyur nas gab dkrugs med par shar 'don gyis/ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs: zhes pa'i bar gyis mtshan ma rdzas dkyil gyi lha rnams bdag mdun tshul du me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar 'don cha tshar gcig gis gsal gdab/ de nas lus dkyil ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags de brjod pa tsam gyis ni: dpal chen gtso bo'i spyi gtsug tu: khro bo'i rgyal po hūm̐ kā ra: yum chen rdo rje sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: 'od dang zer gyi tshul du bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: thugs kar khro bo rnam par rgyal: yum chen rdo rje mda' snyems ma: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par bskyed: oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod nu ma g.yas kyi steng: khro bo dbyug pa sngon po dang: yum chen rdo rje sder mo gnyis: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par bskyed: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod dpung pa g.yas kyi steng: khro bo gshin rje gshed po dang: yum chen dur khrod bdag mo gnyis: sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: las la chas pa lta bur bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐: bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod sog pa g.yas kyi steng: khro bo mi g.yo mgon po dang: yum chen rdo rje gtun khung ma: sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: bka' nyan tshul du bsgom par bya: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī ba hūm̐: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod rgyab kyi sog phrag tu: khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po dang: yum chen rdo rje dbang sdud ma: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: srung ba'i go cha mdzad par bsgom:

oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod sog pa g.yon pa'i steng: khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang: yum chen rdo rje mda' snyems ma: sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo: bka' sdod pho nya'i tshul du bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐: tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang: yum chen rdo rje rlung 'byin ma: sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ mgo: dngos grub chen po'i pho nyar bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod nu ma g.yon pa'i steng: khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang: yum chen khro mo gsod byed ma: sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo: dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i srung mar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā ba la hūm̐: s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod 'og gi bcu drug mdor: khro bo 'jigs byed stobs po che: yum chen rdo rje skyod byed ma: sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo: bka' sdod tshul du gsal bar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta s+pha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sku lus rgya khyon thams cad du: ba spu re la khro chung re: 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thogs nas kyang: srung byed khrab tu gtams par bsgom: oṃ badz+ra gha ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: lte ba'i gnas su sprul pa'i khyung: dung mdog lcags kyi gshog pa can: gser mig 'khyil ba rdo rje'i lus: mchu sder lcags kyi sbrul bzung nas: gdug pa can rnams zas su za: de ltar shin tu gsal bar bsgom: sras mchog rdzas kyi dal bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: thugs kyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: mthing nag phyag gnyis rgya gram phur bu bsgril: sku smad zur gsum drag po'i dbal dang ldan: rdo rje gshog pa dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:

sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: mthing nag gru gsum steng du bzhugs su gsol: de nas sgo ma bka' srung bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dhā ti ma ma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye swā hā: de las dam can ma mo bcu gnyis po: bar khyams gnas la rang rang cha lugs rdzogs: pho brang sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas: nyi ma zhing rkyang gdan la phyogs bzhi ru: dkar mo pu shud mgo can lcags kyu thogs: ser mo skya ka'i mgo can zhags pa thogs: dmar mo srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrog thogs: ljang mo khra yi mgo can dril bu thogs: dpal gyi thugs las spros te bskyed par bya: pho brang phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus: bse lcags dung la sogs pa'i pho nya bzhugs: de ltar gzhal yas lha tshogs gsal bar bsgom: de nas srog ye shes su bskyed nas srog la dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rjer sgrub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs bya'i phyir: dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyis khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par bsam: de nas spyan drang ba ni: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par bzhengs nas byon par bsam la: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: mi 'gyur ye shes lha tshogs kyi: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: e h+ye hi bha ga bān sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes: dngos grub rtags mtshan bstan pa dang: kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol:

badz+ra ā be sha ya ā: mkha' la char sprin gtibs pa bzhin du byon: don gnyis ma 'grub bar du brtan par bzhugs: de nas phyag bya ba ni: hūm̐: srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang: nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas dbyer med du bstim pa ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs pa: bdag dang dbyer med thim gyur la: rab tu dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa phan tshun du phyag gi brda stob cing dbyer med du bstim/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: 'dod yon mang pos bde gshegs mchod: dri zhim spos rnams shangs la 'bul: me tog mdzes pa spyan la 'bul: gsal ba'i sgron me thugs la 'bul: gtsang ma'i dri chab sku la 'bul: bcud ldan lha bshos ljags la 'bul: snyan pa'i rol mo snyan la 'bul: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta: sid+dhi sa ma ya ho: oṃ shrī rā gā badz+ra dhū pe dhū: puṣ+pe trāṃ: ā lo ke hrī: gan+dhe gan: nai bid+ya ā: gīrti hrī: de nas sman rag gtor ma sbyor sgrol sogs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: bdud 'dul 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: zhing chen gsar rnying bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: sprul pa'i mgo brnyan khra thabs nyi shu la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: srid gsum gdug pa 'dul bar zhal bzhes pa'i: sras mchog chen po phrin las grub pa la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes sgo skyong sgo ma bzhi rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: dam can phur skyong srung ma thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: a la la ho: hūm̐: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor chen po: chos nyid skye med klong nas sprul: 'dod yon sna lngas rab tu spras: dpal chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: nyon mongs rtsa ba 'khor ba'i khrag: bhan+dha'i nang du dmar chen bskyil: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du 'bul:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā rak+ta khā hi: dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab: phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab: shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab: sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab: khyod kyi phrin las dus la bab: mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba kun: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas: mngon spyod tshul bzhin sgrol ba dang: lus ngag rdul phran bshigs nas kyang: sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: pra be sha ya phaṭa: ā be sha ya ā: hūm̐: dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: btogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis: rings par khug la smyo ru chugs: phobs shig rnam par gzir bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas ni: bsgo ba'i las rnams nyan par gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: mo hā ghā ta ya: bha ga bān: shi krin bi krin badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: mā ra se na pra ma ya ti: sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba yi: gti mug sha chen spungs se spung: 'dod chags khrag mtsho me re re: zhe sdang rus pa khro lo lo: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: hūm̐: khro mo 'bar ba'i mkha' dbyings su: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i khro tshogs kyis: rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas: lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya: kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: badz+ra yak+sha kro ta bi dza ya khā hi khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal: rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag shes rab gsal ba'i dpal: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa bcu'i mnga' bdag zhing bcu sgrol mdzad pa: 'jigs byed khro rgyal bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi dge dag mdzad pha rol phyin bcu'i don: yum chen khro mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: nyon mongs nyi shu gnas su sgrol mdzad pa'i: khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje'i shugs kyis gnod gdug sgrol mdzad pa'i: sras mchog 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i las la brtson: drag po'i sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: phur skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas thugs sgrub ltar/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs kyis bskul la dzap kyi dgongs pa ni/ rang nyid dpal chen skur gsal ba'i: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni: rgyan med yab dang tshul mthun pa: tshon gang pa gcig bsgom par bya: de yi thugs kar phyag mtshan ni: rdo rje rtse dgu nas 'bru tsam: de yi lte bar gsung gi rtags: hūm̐ sngon spu yis bris pa tsam: de yi mtha' mar snying po ni: gsang ba'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa: gser mdog spu shad tsam gyis bskor: de ltar thugs kar bsgoms nas kyang: thugs ka'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas: stong gsum thams cad 'od kyis bkang: srid gsum gdug pa can rnams btul: gsal stong ngang nas sngags 'di bzla: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ ā: grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum: rtags bsnyen rtags byung bar du bzla: mthar phyag bzhes ltar dha ti bdun tsam bzla/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa 'bul la/

rig 'dzin bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnams kyi dus la bab: phur pa sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rgya gar tsan+dan nags tshal la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: paṇa chen bi ma mi tra yis: rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: bal po shī la mañju yis: maṇ+ḍa la yi mkhar rdzong du: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: mchim ston shākya pra bhā yis: yar lung gad kyi brag phug tu: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: shud pu dpal gyi seng ge yis: 'u shang rdo yi brag logs la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis: has po ri yi yang gong du: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis: rtsib kyi spyang ki sngon mo la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: nam mkha'i pho rog nag po la: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: phur bu brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: rang rang so so'i sgrub khang du: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig:

ces bskul lo: de nas bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi mchod phrin skong bshags bcas pa'am/ mi 'grub na bka' srung spyi mchod rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ phur srung gtor 'bul dngos rol rjes 'brang lta bu gang bde bya'o// de nas tshogs mchod la/ bsang chu dang bdud rtsi bran la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo 'khor bcas rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa sbyar ba ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: de nas tshogs phud gsum du bcad la/ dang po mchod de 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kun: tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs bar chad phyir la zlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: bar pa bshags te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: tha ma bstab ste 'bul ba ni/ dgra bgegs kyi liṅga bcas la bden pa brdar/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: pra be sha ya phaṭa: ā be sha ya ā: zhes bkug bstim dbye/ gdab phur blangs la/ hūm̐: sku stod khro bo chen po la: sku smad zur gsum dbal dang ldan: khro bo bcu yis rnam par brgyan: gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar byos: nṛ tri e hur thum dza: mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes gdab/ zhal bstab ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig:

zhal ni hom khung gdangs pa 'dra: tshems ni hom shing btsugs pa 'dra: ljags ni hom gzar brkyangs pa 'dra: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i phung po 'di: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du bstab: nṛ tri sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: de nas rtsa gsum skong gso btang la gnam phud 'thor/ tshogs la rol zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ ho: dgongs su gsol: chos nyid kyi bden pa'o: sangs rgyas kyi mthu'o: gsang sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo: a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la bab bo: brnag pa'i las kho na'o: de ltar gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba spyad pa'i mthu byin gyis bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod cing skal pa mnyam par gyur cig: de nas lhag ma gtang ba ni: e bh+rūm̐ gtor gzhong drag po'i gzhal yas su bsam la: de'i nang du ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti hūm̐: gtor ma sha chen gyi phung po khrag gi rgya mtsho: keng rus kyi ri rab chen por bsam la: spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐: sha chen ri ltar spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis gshegs su gsol: keng rus rtsig par gtams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad gshegs su gsol: tsit+ta gsar rnying spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad gshegs su gsol: tshil chen 'od ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: 'bar ma rgyu phreng tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag mtsho ltar khol ba'i dur khrod nas: ma bdun sring bzhi dam can gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas nas: pho nya sum brgya drug cu gshegs su gsol: ṭā ki hūm̐ dza: sarba pū dza khā hi: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: ye shes lha la dbang nos pas: 'gro ba'i don du bskul kyang 'tshal: bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod du:

ma mo mkha' 'gro mchod nas kyang: phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub kyang 'tshal: lhag ma kha chus mi bran du: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya rnams: sngon gyi dam tshig de la bca': rnam pa gcig tu mi bsre ru: lam gyi bya ba so so ste: chos kyi dbyings su thams cad gcig: de nas mkha' 'gro mchod pa ni: hūm̐: zla gam dmar po dbang gi gzhal yas su: lhag ma'i phung po gling bzhi ri rab tsam: gti mug sha yi lhu dum nyi li li: 'dod chags khrag gi rba rlabs chi li li: zhe sdang rus pa'i phung po khro lo lo: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dam can sum cu gnyis: dbang phyug chen po nyi shu dang: skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad dang: lang ka dur khrod bdag po dang: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi: 'bar ma brgyad dang zhing skyong dang: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams: lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sarba pū dza khā hi: zhes brjod la lhag ma phyi rol du gtang*/ de nas rgyas par thugs sgrub ltar chad tho gtang zhing bka' srung gtor ma 'bul/ bshal chus brtan ma bskyang*/ bsdu na brtan skyong 'di tsam gyis kyang 'thus te/ hūm̐: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: phyi gtor lhag la dbang ba rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis: dam sri bar chad rdul du rlogs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ: dam sri bar chad thams cad nṛ tri sarba s+t+wam+bha ya nan: zhes mnan par bya'o// dpal chen 'khor bcas rol pa'i bro: dam sri'i snying la chems se chem: khro bo khro mo rol pa'i bro: dgra bgegs snying la chems se chem: khro bo rnams kyis bro brdungs pas: khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so:

ig nan: big nān: s+t+wam+bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rjer sgrub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod: ces sh+loka gcig dang*/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs bya'i phyir: dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig: ces sh+loka gcig gis bskul la/ sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba las dngos grub blang*/ 1$0000250ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdud rtsir 1$0000300 bsam la rol/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: 'dod yon mang pos sogs kyis mchod/ sman gtor rak+ta sngags tsam gyis 'bul/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ rten yod na mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ bdag nyid rtsa dkyil dang mtshan ma rdzas dkyil gnyis/ hūm̐: da ni dkyil 'khor gsal btab la: phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun: yig 'bru hūm̐ la hril gyis bsdu: hūm̐ yang mi dmigs 'ja' ltar yal: de nas bdag nyid lha ru gsal: rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' bsal lo: zhes rdzogs rim du bsdu/ snying po brjod la/ slar bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gsal ba me dpung gi klong na rdo rje'i go bgos par gyur par bsam la rgyun spyod bya/ dge bsngo bkra shis rgyas par brjod la bde legs su bya'o// lha brag gter bcud phur pa lugs// gsum las 'bring po spu gri yi// phrin las rig 'dzin gong ma'i srol// bslad med bklags pas grub pa bsdebs// gdug can mi dang mi min tshar gcod cing*// dka' ba med par byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs// thal 'byin dgongs pas khams gsum dbyings su bsgral// srid bcud ye shes phyag rgya che 'grub shog
/ces pa'ang pad+ma'i rjes 'jug sngags rig 'dzin pa pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rang 'dra'i gsos sman du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
